bio: The culinary flagship of the Travel Charme Strandidyll hotel. From your table in the fourth-floor dining area, which with its glass dome has an elegant modern feel , you can take in the wonderful view over the hotel grounds all the way to the Baltic Sea. The cuisine is classic in its foundations and partly based on regional produce. You are free to put together your own set menu. Friendly and well-drilled waitstaff. Tip: Your aperitif is best enjoyed on the gorgeous terrace....
